failure_summary.description: The agent chose an associated or overly broad answer despite existing guidance to identify the clue's target, honor its specificity, and avoid truth judgments unless explicitly requested.
The skill does not cover bare person-name prompts or clearly supported source/inspiration relations in terse work clues.

patch.reasoning: Most failures already match rules in the skill, so repeating those rules would not address the gap. Add guidance only for bare person-name prompts and for terse work clues whose context points to a source or inspiration rather than a genre.

edits.content: For a prompt consisting only of a person's name, treat it as an elliptical request for an identifying relation only when context makes one relation clearly salient (for example, the country associated with a ruler); answer that relation rather than the person's title. If context does not make the intended relation clear, do not guess.

edits.target: For a prompt consisting only of a named work and year, infer the intended identifying relation from context; prefer a person or attribution repeatedly and directly associated with the work over a genre label, unless the prompt asks for its genre.
edits.content: For a terse work clue consisting of a title with a year or brief label, infer the intended identifying relation from the clue and context rather than defaulting to genre. When context distinctly identifies the work as a retelling, adaptation, or inspiration of another work and that relation fits the clue, give the source or inspiration; otherwise follow the relation the clue supports, including a person or attribution when appropriate.
